candidates.title: Site Engineer
candidates.abstract: Join an exciting marine infrastructure project in WA's Mid West, delivering quality engineering outcomes on a FIFO 2:1 roster
bullets: Permanent full time opportunity with ongoing opportunities
Stable pipeline of work across the WA portfolio
candidates.content_text:
About the role 
We’re seeking a motivated Site Engineer to support the delivery of an exciting marine infrastructure project in the Mid West region of Western Australia, on a FIFO 2:1 roster.
 Working closely with the Construction Manager, supervisors, subcontractors and project teams, you’ll play a key role in coordinating site activities, maintaining quality and safety standards, and ensuring works are delivered in line with project specifications and schedules. This is an opportunity to build your experience on a major infrastructure project while contributing to a strong team focused on safe, efficient and high-quality delivery.
Key responsibilities - Coordinate site engineering activities, interpreting drawings and resolving technical issues to support construction delivery.
 - Implement quality requirements, including Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), inspections, testing and quality documentation.
 - Monitor progress, costs and schedules, identifying and escalating risks or deviations.
 - Support procurement, subcontractor coordination, work packages and progress claims.
 - Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with project procedures, environmental requirements and the McConnell Dowell Management System.
Don’t tick all the boxes? If you don’t meet every requirement but have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. You may be a great fit for this role or other opportunities within McConnell Dowell.
 What will you bring?  - A relevant tertiary qualification in civil engineering, construction engineering or a related discipline.
 - Ideally, at least two years’ experience in a construction or engineering environment (marine experience highly benefitial).
 - A sound understanding of construction safety, quality assurance and engineering documentation.
 - A current Australian driver’s licence and White Card.
What’s in it for you?  - The opportunity to contribute to an exciting marine infrastructure project in WA’s Mid West.
 - A FIFO 2:1 roster, offering a structured work and time-off cycle.
 - Hands-on experience across site engineering, construction delivery and quality management.
 - Career development opportunities within a leading engineering and construction business.
About Us | McConnell Dowell – Creative Construction
 Our purpose is Providing a Better Life. For more than 60 years, we’ve delivered high-quality, complex projects across Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific Islands, and Southeast Asia, connecting communities and supporting economic growth. 
 We offer a wide variety of projects, roles, and locations, with opportunities to develop your career through mentoring, training, and hands-on experience. Our culture is collaborative, supportive, and inclusive, where you can make a real impact on both projects and people’s lives. We are committed to creating an environment where our people feel valued, supported, and able to grow.
We actively celebrate diversity and inclusion, encouraging all individuals to bring their ideas and be themselves.
 All successful applicants must hold valid work rights for Australia and pass a satisfactory pre-employment medical, which may include drug and alcohol checks.
 Join us, be you, and help create better together. Apply now!
This role is being sourced through McConnell Dowell directly and we are not accepting applications via external recruitment agencies.
